# LocalizedAttribute

Namespace `AutoSettings.Sdk` · attribute

```csharp
public sealed class LocalizedAttribute : Attribute
```

A translated title and description for a component, for example in Turkish.

**Example**

`[Localized("tr", "USB sürücüyü çıkar", Description = "USB sürücüyü güvenle kaldırır.")]`

## Constructors

```csharp
public LocalizedAttribute(string language, string title)
```

Adds a translation.

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `language` | Two-letter language code, for example `tr`. |
| `title` | The title in that language. |

### Type

